scope: Daily full-universe verification across Power / Grid, AI / Data centres, Nuclear, Uranium / Fuel, Oil & Gas, Metals, Robotics / Automation and established adjacent themes in US, Hong Kong/China and Malaysia.
decision: No new idea, promotion or conviction change cleared the bar today. Preserve the Aug 24 hierarchy and increase valuation/cycle discipline rather than manufacture turnover.

macro.ism: July 2026 remains the latest official ISM dataset: Manufacturing PMI 55.6 and Services PMI 54.1. August Manufacturing and Services reports are due Sep 1 and Sep 3 respectively.
macro.manufacturingRead: New Orders 56.7, Production 58.5, Employment 52.8, Supplier Deliveries 58.9, Inventories 51.2, Customers' Inventories 40.7, Prices 71.1, Backlog 55.0, New Export Orders 53.0 and Imports 55.7. Electrical/electronic demand plus too-low customer inventories and shortages in copper, electrical/electronic components, ICs, memory and semiconductors remain the most important Power Stack signal.
macro.servicesRead: Business Activity 59.1 and New Orders 57.2 remain strong, but Employment 47.4 contracts and Prices 70.3 remain elevated. Switchgear, transformers, wire/cable, memory and electronic-component constraints continue to validate physical bottlenecks while raising execution risk for contractors.
macro.oil: WTI settled Aug 25 near $82.36 and Brent near $88.58 as diplomacy/sanctions headlines reduced the immediate Hormuz war premium. Refined-product scarcity remains more structurally interesting than generic crude beta: Asian refined-product imports remain materially below pre-conflict levels and refining margins elevated.
macro.riskRead: AI-capex scrutiny and recent weakness in higher-duration AI equities reinforce preference for contracted backlog, pricing power and physical bottlenecks over concept exposure.

categoryReview.Power / Grid: UNCHANGED. GEV/PWR/ETN remain high-quality core research; GNRC's approximately $1.6bn data-centre backlog and two hyperscaler relationships validate backup-power reliability as a first-class adjacency. Do not chase without valuation discipline.
categoryReview.AI / Data centres: UNCHANGED. BDC remains the best differentiated new research candidate from the Aug 24 pass: Q2 record orders $836m, +19% y/y, 1.11 book-to-bill, with AI-data-centre demand entering the order book. AMKR/ASMPT remain preferred advanced-packaging/HBM infrastructure adjacencies. Existing high-beta VRT/NationGate-type names require a wider valuation margin.
categoryReview.Nuclear: UNCHANGED. BWXT/CEG/1816.HK remain preferable to development-stage SMR/OKLO risk on earnings visibility and operating-asset quality.
categoryReview.Uranium / Fuel: UNCHANGED. CCJ/LEU remain the cleaner scarcity/fuel-cycle expressions; no fresh evidence today justifies adding another uranium beta duplicate.
categoryReview.Oil & Gas: UNCHANGED CORE / TACTICAL PRODUCT BIAS. XOM/CVX/CNOOC remain quality upstream/integrated exposures, but falling crude despite sanctions argues against upgrading generic oil beta. STNG/1138.HK and VLO/MPC remain tactical refined-product/logistics expressions.
categoryReview.Metals: UNCHANGED. Copper remains the highest-relevance structural metal because ISM still reports copper up in price and in short supply alongside electrical components. Palladium remains low-priority.
categoryReview.Robotics / Automation: UNCHANGED ADOPTION SEQUENCE. Warehouse/fixed industrial automation remains first, followed by cobots/mobile manipulation, then industrial humanoids and finally open-world/general-purpose robots. SYM/CGNX/2590.HK remain the strongest direct/picks-and-shovels research expressions; TER remains crossover exposure and 9880.HK speculative.
categoryReview.Malaysia: UNCHANGED. TNB/YTLPOWR/Southern Cable/MNHLDG remain the main differentiated physical-stack exposures. DIALOG remains a reassessment rather than a new idea. No new Malaysian stock cleared the quality/relevance bar today.
categoryReview.Hong Kong / China: UNCHANGED. ASMPT remains the strongest differentiated recent candidate via advanced packaging/HBM/photonics; existing 1816.HK/0836.HK/1072.HK/CNOOC retain their category roles.
categoryReview.Adjacent themes: Power reliability, AI memory/advanced packaging and physical-AI networking remain active. Sanctions/maritime intelligence and marine war-risk insurance remain real bottlenecks but still lack a clean target-market listed pure play.

existingIdeaReview.result: All existing ideas were re-screened for thesis break, material catalyst/risk change and duplication. No evidence found today requires a conviction/status edit.

newOpportunitySearch.result: No genuinely new US, HK/China or Malaysia name beat the existing queue on differentiated exposure, evidence quality and valuation/cycle risk. Generac and Belden evidence strengthened but they are already in the Aug 24 research queue.
newOpportunitySearch.rule: Prefer differentiated bottleneck economics and contracted demand; reject duplicate thematic beta and weak cash-conversion stories.

researchGaps: Next official ISM Manufacturing update is Sep 1; do not infer August survey internals before publication.
Need another reporting cycle to test durability and cash conversion of the newest BDC/GNRC/AMKR/ASMPT queue.
No clean US/HK/Malaysia listed pure play yet for sanctions/maritime intelligence or marine war-risk insurance.
Refined-product dislocation remains difficult to separate from transient Hormuz risk; keep tanker/refiner expressions tactical.
